description.p: Coxswain is a two-panel file manager in the Norton Commander tradition, built for developers. It finds any file by its name, its text or what it is about, previews over 60 kinds of file, opens archives like folders, shows git in every panel, and keeps everything on your machine.

ul.li: Two panes, driven from the keyboard: F3 to view, F5 to copy, F6 to move, F7 for a new folder, F8 to delete
Find by name in an instant, by the words inside files, or by meaning with a model that runs on your machine
Previews for Markdown, PDF, Office documents, pictures, video, code, data files, diagrams and more
Git status in every panel, the history of a file, and branches and worktrees as folders
Archives open like folders; pack and unpack ZIP, tar and 7-Zip
Eighteen themes, from Norton Commander blue to a green phosphor terminal, and 26 languages

description.p: Nothing leaves the machine unless you ask: the daily update check can be turned off, and a model download or a remote server is your choice in Settings.
